channel.title: MediaToday Co Ltd - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from MediaToday Co Ltd (maltatoday.com.mt)

item.title: Court hands two-year suspended sentence over Rabat crash that killed passenger
item.description: Woman receives two-year jail term, suspended for four years, after admitting to negligent homicide and related motoring offences over an August 2024 motorcycle crash in Rabat which claimed the life of her friend

item.title: AFM rescues 61 migrants as one person is certified dead in Friday morning operation
item.description: One person certified dead and five are hospitalised as 61 migrants are found in distress by Armed Forces of Malta personnel on Friday morning

item.title: Cannabis firm ordered to pay €2.4 million after persistent late rent sparks termination of land lease
item.description: Medical cannabis company JMCC Life Sciences Europe Ltd ordered to pay €2.4 million in penalties and vacate its Ħal Far industrial premises after the Rent Board ruled its long-running pattern of late rental payments triggered the automatic termination of a 15-year lease

item.title: Chucky’s one-person Jack and the Beanstalk panto returns to Spazju Kreattiv
item.description: The adult-only solo panto runs on 19–21 and 26–28 December at Spazju Kreattiv, Valletta, with tickets available online

item.title: Woman cleared of Rolex theft after court questions complainant’s ‘incoherent’ account
item.description: Court says lingering doubts over ownership and a month-long reporting delay undermined the €7,000 theft claim, with the court finding the woman may have acted under a pretended right rather than with criminal intent

item.title: Regulator to pay 25% of flood damage bill after failing to deny Malta Resources Authority debt
item.description: The Regulator for Energy and Water Services has failed in its appeal to evade responsibility for a debt incurred by the defunct Malta Resources Authority for flood-related damages

item.title: New National Bank of Malta lawsuit seeks compensation for remaining shareholders
item.description: Outstanding liability for 1973 takeover could reach €34 million for the third of shareholders of the National Bank of Malta who were not involved in recent case

item.title: Quarter of airports December traffic fuelled by locals
item.description: The Christmas holiday rush at MIA is projected to peak on 27 December, with approximately 70,000 passengers expected across 206 flights

item.title: Man acquitted of all charges over San Ġiljan assault that left bar manager injured
item.description: No evidence could prove that the accused instructed or was involved in the attack on a bar manager

item.title: PA approves ODZ swimming pools in Żabbar despite ERA objection
item.description: The Environment and Resources Authority has warned that the development will encroach into rural area
